evidence.title: traycer README.md
evidence.locator: Introduction; Bring Your Own Agent; Privacy
evidence.finding: Desktop orchestrates parallel coding agents, reuses provider subscriptions and has shared context. Inference and cloud collaboration are separate services.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/install.mdx
evidence.locator: Platforms; Requirements; Mobile App; CLI; After Install
evidence.finding: Desktop installers support macOS 12+, Windows x64 and Linux x64. Mobile apps and a standalone CLI are documented. Desktop first run signs in and prepares the host.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/cli/commands.mdx
evidence.locator: Agent Commands; Agent Context; Read-Only Agents; Examples
evidence.finding: CLI creates tasks and agents, sends messages and reads transcripts. Agent tools depend on Task/agent environment context and interface permissions. A nightly task example uses external cron.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/settings/providers/mcp-servers.mdx
evidence.locator: MCP servers; Choose Where Servers Live; Add A Server
evidence.finding: Provider-specific MCP configuration supports stdio and remote transports with documented authentication. Some providers have no MCP tab.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/tasks-and-workspace-folders.mdx
evidence.locator: Task; How a Task Is Organized
evidence.finding: A Task groups agents, artifacts, workspace folders, terminals, diffs and pull requests. Multiple agents belong to one Task.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/history.mdx
evidence.locator: What History Shows; Search; Filter And Sort; Labels, Groups, And Appearance
evidence.finding: Task history supports search, filters, labels, groups, pinning, renaming and deletion.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/artifact-workflow.mdx
evidence.locator: Built-In Skills; Where Skill Output Lands; Run a Skill
evidence.finding: Planning skills write briefs, technical plans and ticket artifacts. Execute orders tickets by dependency and reviews batches. These are optional skills, not enforced automatic pipelines.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/agent-to-agent.mdx
evidence.locator: What It Does; Agent-To-Agent Support; Messages; Transcripts; Agent Office
evidence.finding: Agents create child sessions, message them and read transcripts, with per-interface and ownership restrictions. Agent Office retains lineage, live state and message replay.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/hosts/remote-hosts.mdx
evidence.locator: Add A Host
evidence.finding: Install CLI on a remote machine, sign in and start the Host as a persistent service. It runs agents and accesses files on that machine.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/account/mobile-app.mdx
evidence.locator: Mobile App; Tasks and Chats
evidence.finding: Phone clients connect through the relay to hosts on other machines. Agents continue there while the phone follows or steers work. Mobile is included in Free.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/concepts/worktrees.mdx
evidence.locator: Run Locations; Setup and Teardown; Where Worktrees Live
evidence.finding: Tasks can use the local folder or new/existing Git worktrees; non-Git folders run Local. Setup and teardown scripts live in repository configuration.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/panels/sharing.mdx
evidence.locator: Roles; Share My Agents; Requirements
evidence.finding: Task Owner/Editor access is documented. Shared agents can be viewed and cloned but collaborators cannot act in them. Individual invites are Free; whole-team sharing needs Sync.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/account/teams.mdx
evidence.locator: Members; Frequently Asked Questions
evidence.finding: Teams have Admin/Member roles. SSO and SAML are explicitly not supported.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/panels/pull-requests.mdx
evidence.locator: Pull Request Rows; Details; Send Feedback To An Agent
evidence.finding: PR panel groups PRs by repository/stack, shows checks and reviews, diffs and commits, and quotes failing checks or review feedback into an agent composer. It requires authenticated gh on the host.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/panels/git-diff.mdx
evidence.locator: Diff toolbar; Edit In Place; Repository Operations
evidence.finding: Product diff UI displays split/unified changes, in-place edits and Git operation states. Line comments are not supported in diffs; discussion belongs to artifacts.

evidence.title: traycer LICENSE
evidence.locator: MIT grant
evidence.finding: MIT license covers the repository at the pinned revision; no hosted-service parity is implied.

evidence.title: traycer mintlify/account/pricing.mdx
evidence.locator: Plans; Inference Credits; What Costs Credits
evidence.finding: Free is $0 with own agents, unlimited sessions, cloud sync, individual sharing, remote hosts and mobile. Sync is $20/user/month or $16 with yearly billing. Optional inference credits use upstream pricing plus 20% markup.

evidence.title: traycer Desktop 1.5.3 release
evidence.locator: Desktop 1.5.3 release
evidence.finding: Desktop 1.5.3 was published 3 November 2026. The source pass also inspected newer default-branch documentation.

evidence.title: Traycer mintlify/panels/artifacts.mdx
evidence.locator: mintlify/panels/artifacts.mdx lines 12-50 (Artifact Types, Status), commit 3b0179f (tag desktop-v1.5.3)
evidence.finding: Tasks hold ticket and story artifacts that track work with a persistent Todo, In Progress or Done status, changed from a status pill and stored in the artifact file on disk.

evidence.title: Traycer mintlify/concepts/artifact-workflow.mdx
evidence.locator: mintlify/concepts/artifact-workflow.mdx lines 48-53 (Build skills: traycer-execute), commit 3b0179f (tag desktop-v1.5.3)
evidence.finding: The traycer-execute skill orders ticket artifacts into dependency batches, starts one child agent per ticket, reviews each batch and marks passing tickets done.

evidence.title: Traycer clients/gui-app/src/lib/analytics.ts
evidence.locator: clients/gui-app/src/lib/analytics.ts lines 3182-3201 (class Analytics constructor), commit 3b0179f (tag desktop-v1.5.3)
evidence.finding: PostHog analytics initialise whenever the build carries a PostHog key and is not a test build; no user-facing switch is read here.

evidence.title: Traycer mintlify/changelog.mdx
evidence.locator: mintlify/changelog.mdx lines 178-178 (Analytics entry), commit 3b0179f (tag desktop-v1.5.3)
evidence.finding: Traycer collects product usage data linked to the Traycer account, with automatic capture, session recording, page addresses, errors and content switched off.

evidence.title: Traycer Antigravity support at desktop-v1.5.3
evidence.locator: mintlify/changelog.mdx lines 40-61, desktop-v1.5.3, commit 3b0179f0d8ce50049bd94ecec1b2c2970d27b8b0
evidence.finding: Traycer desktop-v1.5.3 includes Antigravity, introduced in v1.4.0, using its managed official agy_acp_server runtime.

evidence.title: Traycer Antigravity support at desktop-v1.5.3

evidence.finding: Traycer desktop-v1.5.3 includes Antigravity, introduced in v1.4.0, using its managed official agy_acp_server runtime.
